about.sectionSubtitle: How I think about building software

whatIDo.title: Core Expertise
items: Identity & Access: Privileged access, Just-In-Time approvals and self-service password reset across Active Directory, Entra ID and Google Workspace.
Secrets in Delivery Pipelines: Published Terraform, Jenkins, Ansible, Chef and Puppet plugins that let pipelines use secrets without storing them.
Backend Architecture: APIs and services designed for high throughput, clear failure handling and auditability.
Product Engineering: Taking products from idea to production and running them: data model, UI, deployment and support.

bio.title: Software Engineer
paragraphs: I design and build enterprise security software: the systems that decide who can reach which credential, when, and with whose approval. At Securden that means privileged access workflows, password self-service across multiple directories, and integrations that bring secrets management into CI/CD.

I care about software that holds up in production: clear architecture, careful failure handling and interfaces people can use without a manual. I hold my own products to the same standard, from a portfolio CMS to a zero-knowledge credential manager.
I started building software for clients in 2020 and still make time for students, as a hackathon jury member and guest lecturer.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: PAM • AD/Azure/Google Workspace • DevOps Integrations • Password Self-Service • API
achievements: Architected and built an enterprise-grade Self-Service Password Reset (SSPR) platform with multi-directory support, focusing on high availability and secure architecture.
Engineered robust Password Vault workflows, implementing Just-In-Time (JIT) access, complex approval chains, and secure, policy-based access controls.
Developed secure architectural integrations for major identity providers, including Azure AD, Google Workspace, and Active Directory, ensuring seamless and safe data synchronization.
Built and maintained custom infrastructure plugins for Terraform, Jenkins, Ansible, Chef, and Puppet to enable secure CRUD operations on secrets within CI/CD pipelines.
Enhanced secure browser extension, creating encrypted and user-friendly credential autofill ecosystem.
